title: Heavy-Light Decomposition: Mental Model
idea: Choose one heavy child per node so any root path crosses only logarithmically many light edges.
complexity: O(log^2 n) path query · O(n) space

sites.statement: let (mut parent, mut depth, mut size, mut heavy) =
sizes(0, n, graph, &mut parent, &mut depth, &mut size, &mut heavy);
let (mut head, mut position) = (vec![0; n], vec![0; n]);
sizes(u, v, g, parent, depth, size, heavy);
split(heavy[v], h, g, parent, heavy, head, position, timer);
split(u, u, g, parent, heavy, head, position, timer);
